name: Walls Of The Cities
overview: Scripture reveals that city walls in the Old Testament were vital for protection and defense, as seen in the fortified cities of Bashan, Beth-shan, and Abel where walls were integral to warfare and safety. The walls were not only physical barriers but also places where significant events occurred, such as houses built upon them and bodies fastened to them, illustrating their central role in the life and conflict of ancient cities. Additionally, the presence of sentinels and the threat of arrows from the walls emphasize their strategic importance. The biblical narrative also points toward a figurative understanding of city walls, especially in reference to the new Jerusalem, symbolizing divine protection and holiness.
